scope: Exact signatures and small definition comparisons: norm-one unit quaternions, actual four-dimensional SO(4) and its surjective covering, right scalars, real/spatial derivative spans, rho and sigma multiplication order, real representations and central cancellation, actual coefficient sums and generator values, forward lattice image and covariance for all orders r>1.
output:
EI7_v1 : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_1 : IsZLattice ℝ L] (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 < r),
  (∀ (k : QuaternionSpinPair), ∀ f ∈ kernelDerivativeSpace r, (smoothRho k) f ∈ kernelDerivativeSpace r) ∧
    (∀ (f : ↥(kernelDerivativeSpace r)), Summable fun (w : { w : ↥L // w ≠ 0 }) => ‖↑↑f ↑↑w‖) ∧
      (∀ (k : QuaternionSpinPair),
          latticeCoefficientFunctional (rotatedLattice L (quaternionRotation k)) r hr =
            ((coefficientSpinRepresentation r) k) (latticeCoefficientFunctional L r hr)) ∧
        (∀ (k : QuaternionSpinPair),
            (coefficientSO4Representation r) (quaternionSpinCover k) = (coefficientSpinRepresentation r) k) ∧
          ∀ (e : ↥QuaternionSO4),
            latticeCoefficientFunctional (rotatedLattice L ↑e) r hr =
              ((coefficientSO4Representation r) e) (latticeCoefficientFunctional L r hr)
@[reducible] def MathResearch.Fueter.UnitQuaternion : Submonoid ℍ :=
unitary ℍ
@[reducible] def MathResearch.Fueter.QuaternionSpinPair : Type :=
↥UnitQuaternion × ↥UnitQuaternion
@[reducible] def MathResearch.Fueter.QuaternionSO4 : Subgroup (ℍ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℍ) :=
quaternionIsometryDet.ker
def MathResearch.Fueter.quaternionIsometryDet : (ℍ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℍ) →* ℝˣ :=
{ toFun := fun (e : ℍ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] ℍ) => LinearEquiv.det e.toLinearEquiv, map_one' := quaternionIsometryDet._proof_3,
  map_mul' := ⋯ }
def MathResearch.Fueter.kernelDerivativeSpace : ℕ → Submodule ℍᵐᵒᵖ SmoothPunctured :=
fun (r : ℕ) =>
  Submodule.span ℍᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range fun (ν : { ν : Fin 3 → ℕ // ∑ j : Fin 3, ν j = r }) => smoothHigherKernel ↑ν)
def MathResearch.Fueter.smoothPuncturedSpace : Submodule ℍᵐᵒᵖ (ℍ → ℍ) :=
{ carrier := {f : ℍ → ℍ | ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f punctured ∧ f 0 = 0}, add_mem' := @smoothPuncturedSpace._proof_3,
  zero_mem' := smoothPuncturedSpace._proof_4, smul_mem' := ⋯ }
@[reducible] def MathResearch.Fueter.CoefficientFunctional : ℕ → Type :=
fun (r : ℕ) => ↥(kernelDerivativeSpace r) →ₗ[ℍᵐᵒᵖ] ℍ
def MathResearch.Fueter.latticeCoefficientFunctional : (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) →
  [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] → [IsZLattice ℝ L] → (r : ℕ) → 2 ≤ r → CoefficientFunctional r :=
fun (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [DiscreteTopology ↥L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] (r : ℕ) (hr : 2 ≤ r) =>
  { toFun := fun (f : ↥(kernelDerivativeSpace r)) => ∑' (w : { w : ↥L // w ≠ 0 }), ↑↑f ↑↑w, map_add' := ⋯,
    map_smul' := ⋯ }
kernelDerivativeSpace_eq_real_span : ∀ (r : ℕ),
  kernelDerivativeSpace r =
    Submodule.span ℍᵐᵒᵖ (Set.range fun (l : { l : List (Fin 4) // l.length = r }) => smoothKernelPartial ↑l)
quaternionSpinCover_surjective : Function.Surjective ⇑quaternionSpinCover
quaternionRotation_kernel : ∀ (k : QuaternionSpinPair), quaternionRotation k = 1 → k = 1 ∨ k = (-1, -1)
coefficientSigmaLinear_mul : ∀ (r : ℕ) (k l : QuaternionSpinPair) (α : CoefficientFunctional r),
  (coefficientSigmaLinear r (k * l)) α = (coefficientSigmaLinear r k) ((coefficientSigmaLinear r l) α)
coefficientSO4Representation_lift : ∀ (r : ℕ) (k : QuaternionSpinPair),
  (coefficientSO4Representation r) (quaternionSpinCover k) = (coefficientSpinRepresentation r) k
coefficient_SO4_covariance : ∀ (L : Submodule ℤ ℍ) [inst : DiscreteTopology ↥L] [inst_1 : IsZLattice ℝ L] (r : ℕ)
  (hr : 2 ≤ r) (e : ↥QuaternionSO4),
  latticeCoefficientFunctional (rotatedLattice L ↑e) r hr =
    ((coefficientSO4Action r) e) (latticeCoefficientFunctional L r hr)
'MathResearch.Fueter.EI7_v1' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
